test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The cost price of an article is 64% of the marked price. Calculate the gain percentage after allowing a discount of 20%.
solution:
Given:

Cost Price (CP) = 64% of Marked Price (MP)

Discount = 20% of MP

**Concept:**

Gain% = ((Selling Price (SP) - CP)/CP) × 100%

**Solution:**

SP after 20% discount = MP - (20% of MP) ⇒ 0.80 × MP

CP = 0.64 × MP, so Gain% = ((SP - CP)/CP) × 100% ⇒ ((0.80 MP - 0.64 MP)/0.64 MP) × 100% = 25%

**Therefore, the gain percentage is 0.25 or 25%.**
